notes: the first branch («حدثنا محمود بن خالد، وكثير بن عبيد، قالا حدثنا ح») gives its two names and then «ح» with no shaykh written before it; the second branch opens at محمد بن الصباح بن سفيان and the text writes «أخبرنا الوليد، عن أبي عمرو، عن عمرو بن شعيب» once for both: read as the shared tail, but the first branch's missing shaykh is not settled by the rules
the Prophet is the end of the chain; Amr b. Shu'ayb is the last named transmitter
«- قال ابن السرح -» and «وهذا لفظ محمود» are a gloss and a wording variant: left out
